name: kernel-names-3-materia
description: #260 part 1 Tier 2: the materia name table in disc 1's INIT/KERNEL.BIN (sections from semantic/game-text.js KERNEL_NAME_SECTIONS), read inside the run by runner/kernel-names.js. Input: one frame from the title boot point (the check reads the disc, not the run). <kind>_ok: the table builds, no entry fails to decode, and the entry count equals the count measured in tier2 run 479 (PR #266 at 2df958a): item 128, weapon 128, armor 32, accessory 32, materia 96. <kind>_n, <kind>_empty, <kind>_bad: entries, empty entries and entries that fail to decode. Only numbers leave; no name, string or byte.
